newsitem.title: USA: ShopKo says unit growth helped Q3 revenues.
newsitem.headline: ShopKo says unit growth helped Q3 revenues.

text.p: ShopKo Stores Inc said Tuesday solid growth for its ProVantage health services business helped consolidated sales reach $591 million in the third quarter, up from $491 million one year ago.

ProVantage posted sales of $191.8 million in the third quarter ended November 30, compared to $107.8 million in the third quarter of 1995. Overall revenues, including ShopKo's retail operations, reached $594 million, up from $494 million in the corresponding period one year ago.
ShopKo Stores operates 130 stores in 15 states in adddition to its ProVantage health services division.
